explanations.4: overflow-x: auto means if the code is wider than its container, a horizontal scrollbar appears instead of wrapping or being cut off.
explanations.14: align-items: flex-start aligns items to the top of the flex container, useful when items inside have different heights.
explanations.25: white-space: pre preserves all spaces and line breaks exactly as written, so the code formatting doesn't get collapsed.
explanations.32: flex-shrink: 0 prevents this element from shrinking smaller than its natural size when the flex container runs out of space.
explanations.50: border-radius: 50% makes any element into a perfect circle (assuming equal width and height).
explanations.59: transition smoothly animates changes to background color, text color, and border color over 0.15 seconds when the element state changes.
explanations.75: calc(100% + 5px) means position the tooltip 5 pixels below the bottom edge of its parent element.
explanations.89: pointer-events: none makes the tooltip ignore mouse clicks and hovers, so clicks pass through to elements underneath.
explanations.102: transform: rotate(45deg) tilts the small square 45 degrees to create a diamond-shaped arrow pointing up.
explanations.105: This selector applies different tooltip styles when the page is in dark mode (data-theme="dark" attribute is set).
